title.narrative: Cambodia Southeast Asia Disaster Risk Management Project 2

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to improve the disaster and climate resilience of flood-damaged rural roads in Target Areas, improve the capacity of the Government to prepare for and respond to emergencies, and provide immediate and effective response in case of an Eligible Crisis or Emergency.

provider-org.narrative: Japan-World Bank Program for Mainstreaming Disaster Risk Management in Developing Countries – Second Phase

title.narrative: Government staff trained on disaster risk management and climate change adaptation measures
Grievances registered related to delivery of project benefits addressed in a timely manner
Project-financed roads included in maintenance plan of MRD
Road segments for which safety audits have been conducted and recommendations reflected in road design
Gender-responsive physical design features identified and mainstreamed into MRD’s standard design
The number of strategies, action plans, and/or policies with DRM and climate change adaptation principles enhanced
The number of people trained in post-disaster damage & needs assessment (PDNA) capacity building activities
People participating in road safety audit, community-based safety awareness campaign, and risk communication activities to address climate-related disaster risk
MRD employees and contractors receiving on-the-job capacity building to design and implement road rehabilitation or reconstruction with climate resilience considerations
Length of rural roads rehabilitated or reconstructed with climate resilience considerations
Direct project beneficiaries from climate resilient rural roads
Beneficiaries expressing satisfaction with climate-resilient rural road condition
Climate change adaptation and disaster risk management principles embedded into the Rural Road Asset Management (RRAM) System
Emergency Preparedness and Response (EP&R) diagnostics and response needs assessment conducted
Enhanced community engagement for road design piloted
Post-disaster response and recovery guideline for MRD endorsed
Rural climate resilience investment options for Target Areas developed, incorporating latest climate-related disaster information
Vulnerability mapping of MRD infrastructure assets in Target Areas conducted, incorporating latest climate-related disaster information
